player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne {role} wɔ Colonel Blotto.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo adi nkunim wɔ nnipa pii so sen wo tamfo.
Wɔ kɔla biara mu, fa {num_total_units} nnipa pii no mu fa kɔla {field_names}.
Onipa a ɔde nnipa pii kɔ kɔla bi no, ɔno na ɔdi kɔla no, na onipa a ɔdi kɔla pii no, ɔno na ɔdi nkunim wɔ kɔla no.
Sɛ nhwɛso, '[A7 B7 C6]' fa nnipa 7 kɔ A, 7 kɔ B, na 6 kɔ C.
